message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when someone goes “Uno.” | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Green, Blue, Yellow) × 25 cards each (1–9, two of each; 2× “Skip”, 2× “Reverse”, 2× “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit clockwise. The direction can change with a “Reverse” card. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the symbol/value of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; if challenged and found illegal, you must draw four.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbered cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the current color** – even if a Wild was played, the next player must match that color unless they play another Wild. 2. **Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically** – holding them until you’re sure you can play them saves you from drawing extra cards later. 3. **Watch for “UNO” calls** – both to avoid penalties yourself and to catch opponents who forget. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
